content.title: Mission Produce to Acquire Rival Avocado Producer Calavo in $483 Million Deal
content.summary: Mission Produce  has agreed to acquire  Calavo Growers  combining two of the most prominent publicly traded avocado producers.  Calavo stockholders will receive $27 a share as part of the deal, comprising $14.85 in cash and about 0.98 of a share of Mission’s stock for each Calavo share, the companies said Wednesday.  The deal will create more sourcing security and help Mission—one the biggest publicly traded avocado producers in the U.S.—to expand its presence in North America, Mission said.

content.title: Calavo (NASDAQ:CVGW) Misses Q3 CY2025 Revenue Estimates, But Stock Soars 13.4%
content.summary: Fresh produce company Calavo Growers (NASDAQ:CVGW) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 26.6% year on year to $124.7 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.25 per share was 32.4% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Stock surged from Mission Produce's acquisition announcement.
